notes: Assigned original fields only; unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders. Title and DOI verified against supplied source. Rendered PDF pages 4 and 5 inspected. Study identifier 2 locates Experiment 2, but the neutral description does not distinguish immediate versus delayed naming or by-subjects versus by-items tests; locator p. 4 instead contains Experiment 1. No unique target test can be selected. Experiment 2 candidates: immediate RT semantic relatedness F1(1,17)=7.1, p<.02; F2(1,21)=6.4, p<.03; delayed RT semantic relatedness F1(1,17)=7.6, p<.02; F2(1,21)=5.1, p<.04. These are printed F statistics, not converted effects. Participant candidate: 36 allocated half to each naming condition, so 36 / 2 = 18 participants per condition (allocation arithmetic only, not df inference or a final-group sum); no participant exclusions stated. Item candidate: 24 pictures minus explicitly discarded CYGNE = 23 pictures; picture items are distinct from participants and trials. No candidate N promoted to analytic target N. If page 4 were intended instead, Experiment 1 immediate candidates F1=8.5 p<.007, F2=3.4 p=.07; delayed F1=4.1 p<.06, F2=4.4 p<.05. No cross-study merging.
